title: Hollywood Producer Shannon McIntosh, Universal Music U.K.’s Globe Originals Team on Music-Driven Feature Slate
summary: A love story, with Sam Claflin and Simone Ashley attached; a Dusty Springfield project; and a film driven by music by Bastille's Dan Smith and To Kill a King's Ralph Pelleymounter feature on the slate of the longtime Quentin Tarantino collaborator and sync powerhouse.
